text:
elaine: onboarding sampleapp (node) hit a parity bug: embed batching helper returns a null slot + duplicated vector when a token refresh/retry happens mid-batch. reproducible locally with smallbatch=3.

prahlad: can you paste request/response? is it missing or misordered?

elaine: sent 3 items -> got [v1, null, v2]. sent shapes were all 1536. logs show chunk-id changed on retry.

noor: sounds like node batcher maps by positional index at resolution; if retry requeues items indexes drift. python/go map by per-item UID. parity gap.

prahlad: short-term: update quickstart to set EMBED_BATCH=1 and disable client retries. long-term: inject item_id into inputs and echo in response so clients map deterministically. also add defensive check to surface structured error if any slot is null.

elaine: filed GH issue redwood/node#1601 with repro and logs. added onboarding note. ci-bot: CI queued for PR that adds item_id mapping and stableOrder flag.

noor: also watch envelope key variance (embedding vs embeddings vs vector). sampleapps should accept both temporarily and server should standardize to data[i].embedding.

elaine: thanks all
